GATE FIX: check_cost_of_capital.py CRASHED on ARCC's record — effective_rates recorded as a period-keyed mapping where it expected a sequence — and because the gate defers all printing to the end of its loop, the crash produced ZERO output. A CI log would have shown a traceback and nothing else, and my own earlier run of it read as 'no ARCC failures' when it had examined nothing: the empty-result-is-not-a-clean-result failure, inside a gate written to prevent it. The gate now accepts a mapping (a record that names its periods is better evidence, not worse), refuses any other shape with a message, and catches per-study exceptions so one malformed record cannot silence the other twenty-three; an ERROR is never 'allowed for now' on the ratchet. Negative control extended by three cases — the crash shape, a garbage shape and a non-numeric entry — because all seventeen of its existing cases passed while the gate was broken on real data. FOUND BY THE GATE RUNNER, not by me.

WS5 [R-FCAL-01 amended]: the walk-forward becomes an ACTUATOR. engine/walkforward/decision_rule.py is pre-registered and mechanical — a bias is corrected only if it is robust across bootstrap blocks {2,3,4}, its sign holds in every era with at least five cells, and the driver BEATS FREEZE out of sample; the strength is the reliability weight b*max(0,1-se^2/b^2) on the bias's own standard error, which retires the typed half-strength default. Run on all five records: 9 adopt, 37 watch, 42 none out of 88 drivers. It correctly DECLINES PHDC's +1.12 profit bias — the largest number this project has measured about its own method — because that driver loses to 'no change' at skill -1.87, and correcting a bias in a forecast worse than no change is polishing the wrong object. scripts/check_walkforward_actuation.py checks three things from outside: the log reconciles to what the rule adopts, forward drivers sit inside their own p10-p90 or are named and priced, and a crash is never silent. Twelve-case negative control. Four runs seeded on the ratchet because they ran under the PREVIOUS rule; AMOC conforms today.

WS6 [R-VCAL-01] started in the only order that makes it evidence: the PRE-REGISTRATION is written, hashed and committed BEFORE any data — two scores (contemporaneous agreement, and gap closure against subsequent return net of carry, because a fair value struck today is not a forecast of the price in three years and grading it as one is mis-specified), the promotion order fixed in advance with a stop rule that halts the moment a lever would push the pooled bias across zero, a symmetric guard, and a stated falsifier. Then engine/macro_history.py + engine/macro_history/EG.json: the point-in-time archive's SCHEMA and rule, committed with no figures, so every figure added later arrives under a standard rather than setting one. It REFUSES on a bare value, a partial vintage, an absent year and an unregistered tier — verified on all four — because an interpolated vintage corrupts the very error it is scored on and does so invisibly.

WS6 archive: equity risk premium and sovereign default spread SOURCED for every origin 2013-2023 from Damodaran's archived by-year vintages — the premium published AT each origin, both bases, CDS central per [R-COC-01] with 2013 labelled as rating-basis because that vintage publishes no CDS for Egypt. The filename-to-vintage convention was CONFIRMED against each file's own Updated line rather than assumed. TWO EXTRACTION TRAPS CAUGHT BEFORE ANYTHING WAS RECORDED: ctryprem19 and ctryprem20 each carry a STALE 'Date of update' cell four years wrong, sitting beside a correct Updated line — a first pass read the stale one and would have misdated two vintages in an archive whose whole purpose is that the date is right; and the column headings change between eras, so a matcher written against one era silently returned None for the other. CPI is held only as the CURRENTLY REPORTED World Bank series under cpi_annual_current_vintage, which deliberately does NOT satisfy the required cpi_annual: a revised or rebased figure is fabricated in VINTAGE even when right in value. Every origin still reports unusable, which is the archive working.
